# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 48 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_048_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 48

**1** Jesus said: "If two make peace with each other in this one house, they will say to the mountain, 'Move away!' and it will move away."

---

**Consensus Notes (SOPHIA):**

**"This one house"** — LOGOS/EMET preferred over PNEUMA's "the same house." The demonstrative "this" is specific; the house is the community of disciples.

**"Move away"** — LOGOS/EMET preferred over PNEUMA's "get out of the way." The Coptic *parage* = to pass away/depart (the same verb as Saying 42, "passers-by," and Saying 11, "this sky will pass away"). The verbal echo matters.

**Synoptic Parallels:**
- Matt 17:20: "If you have faith like a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move"
- Mark 11:23: "Whoever says to this mountain, 'Be taken up and thrown into the sea,' it will happen"
- Thomas uniquely conditions the mountain-moving power on peace between two people, not on faith alone.
